contract: Compare the text packet handoff and restart contracts on the authored ISO BMFF tx3g and Matroska UTF-8 tracks. Reject a non-packet event and return its owner.

Check that the packet source exposes only the correct container accessor and preserves the entire payload, track identity and input generation. Check the same source when the bridge refuses a stale generation and when it publishes a cue.

Reset with a packet pending. Require the old generation to be refused, drain without a stale cue, then reset and replay the complete packet. A document supplied through TextSource::document preserves its input and exposes neither packet accessor. All decoded cue data remains compared by bridge-text-subtitles.
